column1: # Run-state classification for save/restart/reset (#128; IEEE 1800-2023 D.8, D.9
# One row per data member of the classes listed in
# fails on a member without a row or a row without a member).
#   P     plain value, saved as is
#   P+ids saved with ids/handles rebound on restore
#   C     closure: saved only through a registered scheduler event kind (an
#   D     derived: rebuilt from saved state or the artifact
#   S     scratch: empty at the save point (a non-empty one refuses the save with
#         FSIM-SAVE-0011; an exact check beside an FSIM_RS_IDLE marker tests it)
#   W     working storage or cache: assigned or cleared before every use (the
#         note names the site), so its content at rest is dead and a restore
#         starts it afresh; no check, no state
#   Cfg   configuration or hook: rebuilt from the same command line
# Rows marked "unreviewed" or "(S5)/(S6)/(S7)" are classified from the declaration
# and are re-checked when the wave that saves them lands.
